body.x: Handheld fans and neck fans move warm air around, and in hot weather that does only so much. Mist-assisted cooling is one way personal cooling devices try to do more.
Aecooly has spent years working on that approach.

Shenzhen Aikuli Technology Co.,Ltd, which sells portable cooling products under the Aecooly brand and is represented by Keli Chen, is exhibiting at KES 2026 in Hall B, Booth B128 and B129. The company is showing its Cold Air Series, which combines airflow and fine mist, together with the newly launched AirGimbal, the Air Mate modular phone fan, the Click magnetic neck fan and other products.

Aecooly's range includes handheld fans, neck fans and mist-assisted cooling devices, and the brand holds more than 180 patents worldwide. According to the company's in-house laboratory testing, the Cold Air Ultra can reduce perceived temperature by about 10 degrees Celsius within 10 seconds. The company continues to research mist-based cooling and applies it to new products.

Aecooly's products have won international design awards. The Aero Series received a Red Dot Award and an iF Design Award in 2025, the Cold Air Series won a Red Dot Award in 2026, and AirGimbal received both an iF Design Award and a Red Dot Award.

At KES 2026, the company wants to present its latest products to buyers, industry guests and media, share its product roadmap and gather market feedback. It is looking for Korean retailers and distribution partners to explore the South Korean consumer electronics market, and it plans to look further at Asian consumer electronics markets after the show. Aecooly names the cost and duration of regional certification and the difficulty of finding reliable local retail and distribution partners as its main challenges, and it says market information, buyer matching and industry networking would help.

KES 2026, the 57th Korea Electronics Show, runs Oct. 13 to Oct. 16 at COEX Halls A and B in Seoul. Alongside the co-located XR & Spatial Computing Show, the event features X-SPACE 2026, a special exhibition covering digital twins, industrial XR, spatial intelligence, XR devices and spatial computing platforms. The Innovation Awards ceremony takes place on Oct. 13.
